mutations.name: KB-1 tracking trigger puts a deleted author back
mutations.sql: create or replace function public.trigger_set_user_tracking() returns trigger language plpgsql set search_path = '' as $f$ begin if TG_OP = 'INSERT' then new.created_by = auth.uid(); new.updated_by = auth.uid(); else new.updated_by = auth.uid(); new.created_by = old.created_by; end if; return new; end $f$;

mutations.name: KB-1 tracking trigger lets any UPDATE clear an author
mutations.sql: create or replace function public.trigger_set_user_tracking() returns trigger language plpgsql set search_path = '' as $f$ begin if TG_OP = 'INSERT' then new.created_by = auth.uid(); new.updated_by = auth.uid(); else if (old.created_by is not null and new.created_by is null) or (old.updated_by is not null and new.updated_by is null) then return new; end if; new.updated_by = auth.uid(); new.created_by = old.created_by; end if; return new; end $f$;

mutations.name: KB-1 membership guard refuses the key's set null
mutations.sql: create or replace function kit.prevent_memberships_update() returns trigger language plpgsql set search_path = '' as $f$ begin if new.account_role <> old.account_role then return new; end if; raise exception 'Only the account_role can be updated'; end $f$;

mutations.name: KB-1 fact rules refuse the key's set null
mutations.sql: create or replace function public.enforce_verified_facts_update_rules() returns trigger language plpgsql security definer as $f$ BEGIN IF NEW.project_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.project_id THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cannot move a fact to a different project'; END IF; IF NEW.created_by IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_by THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cannot change created_by'; END IF; IF NEW.claim IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.claim THEN NEW.verification_status := 'unverified'; NEW.verified_by := NULL; NEW.verified_at := NULL; END IF; NEW.updated_by := auth.uid(); RETURN NEW; END $f$;

mutations.name: KB-1 fact rules let any UPDATE clear an author
mutations.sql: create or replace function public.enforce_verified_facts_update_rules() returns trigger language plpgsql security definer as $f$ BEGIN IF (OLD.created_by IS NOT NULL AND NEW.created_by IS NULL) OR (OLD.updated_by IS NOT NULL AND NEW.updated_by IS NULL) OR (OLD.verified_by IS NOT NULL AND NEW.verified_by IS NULL) THEN RETURN NEW; END IF; IF NEW.project_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.project_id THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cannot move a fact to a different project'; END IF; IF NEW.created_by IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_by THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cannot change created_by'; END IF; IF NEW.claim IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.claim THEN NEW.verification_status := 'unverified'; NEW.verified_by := NULL; NEW.verified_at := NULL; END IF; NEW.updated_by := auth.uid(); RETURN NEW; END $f$;

mutations.name: KB-1 snapshot: fact name trigger dropped
mutations.sql: drop trigger verified_facts_snapshot_verifier_name on public.verified_facts;

mutations.name: KB-1 snapshot: event name only set on insert
mutations.sql: drop trigger immutable_events_snapshot_creator_name on public.immutable_events; create trigger immutable_events_snapshot_creator_name before insert on public.immutable_events for each row execute function public.immutable_events_snapshot_creator_name();

mutations.name: KB-1 snapshot: event name follows a cleared key
mutations.sql: create or replace function public.immutable_events_snapshot_creator_name() returns trigger language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $f$ begin if tg_op = 'INSERT' or new.created_by is distinct from old.created_by then new.created_by_name := kit.author_display_name(new.created_by); else new.created_by_name := old.created_by_name; end if; return new; end $f$;

mutations.name: KB-1 snapshot: fact name follows a cleared key
mutations.sql: create or replace function public.verified_facts_snapshot_verifier_name() returns trigger language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $f$ begin if new.verified_by is not null then if tg_op = 'UPDATE' and new.verified_by is not distinct from old.verified_by then new.verified_by_name := old.verified_by_name; else new.verified_by_name := kit.author_display_name(new.verified_by); end if; else new.verified_by_name := null; end if; return new; end $f$;

mutations.name: KB-1 snapshot: fact name outlives the verification
mutations.sql: create or replace function public.verified_facts_snapshot_verifier_name() returns trigger language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $f$ begin if new.verified_by is not null then if tg_op = 'UPDATE' and new.verified_by is not distinct from old.verified_by then new.verified_by_name := old.verified_by_name; else new.verified_by_name := kit.author_display_name(new.verified_by); end if; elsif tg_op = 'UPDATE' then new.verified_by_name := old.verified_by_name; else new.verified_by_name := null; end if; return new; end $f$;

mutations.name: KB-1 snapshot: fact name re-read on every update
mutations.sql: create or replace function public.verified_facts_snapshot_verifier_name() returns trigger language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $f$ begin if new.verified_by is not null then new.verified_by_name := kit.author_display_name(new.verified_by); elsif tg_op = 'UPDATE' and new.verified_at is not null then new.verified_by_name := old.verified_by_name; else new.verified_by_name := null; end if; return new; end $f$;

mutations.name: KB-1 snapshot: fact name trigger fires before the update rules
mutations.sql: alter trigger verified_facts_snapshot_verifier_name on public.verified_facts rename to a_verified_facts_snapshot_verifier_name;

mutations.name: KB-1 snapshot: name read as the caller, not as definer
mutations.sql: alter function public.immutable_events_snapshot_creator_name() security invoker; grant usage on schema kit to authenticated; grant execute on function kit.author_display_name(uuid) to authenticated;

mutations.name: KB-1 snapshot: empty display name kept as ''
mutations.sql: create or replace function kit.author_display_name(author uuid) returns text language sql stable set search_path = '' as $f$ select name from public.accounts where id = author and is_personal_account $f$;
